title: On Chen-Teo geometries with cosmological constant
summary: The Chen-Teo geometry is a Riemannian, Ricci-flat ALF 4-manifold, containing an AF gravitational instanton that gives the first counterexample to the Euclidean black hole uniqueness conjecture. We investigate the problem of constructing an Einstein analogue with a non-zero cosmological constant $λ$. We show that the solution is either the Plebański-Demiański metric with $λ$, or it has an anti-self-dual Weyl tensor.
